name: negative-text-reel
label: Negative-text reel with motion cards
format: 9:16 talking-head reel (phone or camera A-roll), b-roll cut between lines, negative captions, motion cards behind the speaker

captions.composite: Difference (CompositeMode 3): letters show the video in negative
captions.keywords: plan 'kw': key words big (x1.55), rest of the line smaller, stacked in reading order; heaviest on the hook
captions.hook: first 2-3 words in hook_big (zoom 2.4) over the zoom-out
captions.animation: original smooth ease-in, 9 frames, letter delay 0.25, blur 0.12 -> 0 by frame 6

aroll.jump_cuts: bare joins get the 112% punch toggle

broll.rule: no clip used twice (except the hook clip if Eoin asks for two moments)
broll.sources: client's old-self / story footage for the past, cinematic angles (not the head-on stage shot) for the present, photos for status / purpose lines
broll.hook: straight into the strongest visual within the first ~1s

cards: motion card (screenshot, IG header) fades + lifts in behind the speaker's head on the trigger word, speaker cut out in front (tools/cards.py)

music.rule: bed trimmed to its kick-in so it hits on frame one, never notdavid
music.example: do i clench my fists_.mp3 start 1.28 gain -13.6

deliver: tools/deliver.py renders the timeline as is, finishes, trims the black tail, deletes older renders
